body:
Next native Serenity slice is in engine homes, still not Iris.

Camera UBO is 4576: serenityControls[9] at 4304, previousViewProjection at 4448, invViewProjection at 4512. TAA now reprojects from closest depth + those matrices and neighborhood-clamps history. Exposure_Speed mixes local vs wide luminance (no GPU histogram yet). NativeScenePreview applies world-XZ cloud shadows when VOLUMETRIC_CLOUDS is on. Radiance adds screen-space water refraction off the G-buffer water bit.

Shipped keys: Exposure_Speed, CLOUD_SHADOW_STRENGTH, WATER_REFRACTION. ProcessingStackSmoke, NativeSerenityColorStageSmoke, and Generate-SerenityAdapter.py --check passed.

Still gaps: voxel LPV volume, GPU histogram, layered cloud shadow maps, water refraction volumes, closest-velocity motion vectors. Cube Test binary rebuilt; press H if you are not already on serenity.
